title: Python: a dotted attribute chain through a namespace directory does not resolve (GCLI-91 residual)
description: After GCLI-91, class C(pkg.ns.mod.Base) following import pkg.ns.mod, with ns a directory lacking __init__.py, still leaves C with an unresolved base (resolved-external), though the same chain resolves once ns has an __init__.py (measured on the GCLI-91 branch, scratch fixture src/pkg/sansio/app.py). Not covered by DEC-303 (a26); behaviour unchanged by GCLI-91. Needs an opum-doc ruling before a change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: a fixture for the dotted base through a namespace directory is red before and green after, or the limit is stated in the README under a ruling
